summary: Iteration 6 — Full end-to-end verification of the Lovreski Premium/SBP flow (backend + frontend). All 12 spec items PASS. Backend pytest: 8/8 green. Playwright UI: registered fresh user, verified sbp-phone=+79780369381, Sberbank-only badge, Insufficient Balance toast, pending tx creation with payment_method='SBP (Sberbank)', admin approval → celebration overlay appears within 5s with '🎉 Premium активирован!' + Crown, rejected tx shows 'Причина: <reason>' row, global AuthContext poll flips is_premium (verified via /api/auth/me), Admin Settings tab renders admin-sbp-phone / admin-save-sbp, saving new phone updates /coins/packages, override wins over env.
critical_code_review_comments: PremiumPage.jsx polling loop calls both /coins/balance AND /coins/transactions every 5s AND await refresh() (which hits /auth/me). That's 3 network calls / 5s per open Premium tab; consider consolidating or increasing interval when tab is hidden (document.visibilityState).
AuthContext also polls /auth/me every 15s globally — combined with PremiumPage's refresh() this doubles /auth/me hits while Premium is open. Minor, but worth deduping.
Admin PUT /api/admin/settings accepts arbitrary dict and spreads it into the settings doc (**data). Consider whitelisting keys (sbp_phone, packages) to prevent accidental field pollution.
server.py is 934 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting admin, coins, and auth routers into modules.
